content.title: Happy-Letter Creature Relay | Material Worlds and Ensemble Convergence
content.summary: Five clay creatures ride letter vehicles from separate worlds into the word VIVID. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: Exactly five distinct characters remain bound to five distinct letters. + Each chapter has one environment and one readable travel action. + Letters preserve color, shape and assigned passenger through transit. + The convergence begins only after every module has been established. + The final word is exact, fully readable and contains all five characters.
quick_start.recommended_input: Send one yellow cloud creature riding an orange V across a soft blue paper wave. Carry a purple bean on a cyan V through cotton clouds, then a tan bear on a gold A through one toy city. Fly all five letters into one white studio, assemble the exact word VIVID and seat each creature on its assigned letter.

Each chapter has one environment and one readable travel action.
The convergence begins only after every module has been established.
The final word is exact, fully readable and contains all five characters.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Five clay creatures ride letter vehicles from separate worlds into the word VIVID. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.

creative_dna.mechanism: 五个不同颜色的黏土伙伴各自绑定一个大字母和独立小世界，字母同时是交通载体与身份标记；它们依次穿越浪、草地、云、城市和花田，最后拆件飞入白棚并拼成完整终词。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: Exactly five distinct characters remain bound to five distinct letters.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "Exactly five distinct characters remain bound to five distinct letters."

invariants.rule: Each chapter has one environment and one readable travel action.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Each chapter has one environment and one readable travel action."

invariants.rule: Letters preserve color, shape and assigned passenger through transit.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Letters preserve color, shape and assigned passenger through transit."

invariants.rule: The convergence begins only after every module has been established.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "The convergence begins only after every module has been established."

invariants.rule: The final word is exact, fully readable and contains all five characters.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final word is exact, fully readable and contains all five characters."
